title: GTA VI Radio features unreleased music from CHRIS STASSY, Max Dean, Chloé Caillet, Michael Bibi, more
text:
Facts (DJ Mag, 19 November 2026, by Martin Guttridge-Hewitt). Photo: in-game screenshot of the Vice City harbour at sunset.
Grand Theft Auto VI launched worldwide this week. Early reviews are overwhelmingly positive and some critics already call it one of the greatest video games ever made.
The game has 22 in-game radio stations, a standalone 34-track album, and an original score by French electronic duo Justice. A hidden 23rd station, The Vault Radio, reportedly unlocks when players find a poster inside The Vault, a fictional nightclub in downtown Vice City; it plays the club-focused electronic mixes heard in that venue.
New station: CircoLoco Records Radio, hosted by Seth Troxler. It carries previously unreleased tracks: CHRIS STASSY 'We On This Ride', DJ Tennis 'Never Look Back (ft. Tomike)', Chloé Caillet & Myd 'I Feel Love', Mind Against 'Let It Go', Carlita & Barker 'Last Night', Seth Troxler 'Bootlicker', Black Lounge 'Bickering (Max Dean Remix)', Rossi. & Demi 'Deep N Sexy', Rampa 'The Church (DJ Lag & Palms Trax Remix)'. It also plays released tracks by Michael Bibi, KETTAMA, PAWSA and Skream.
Other stations: Worldwide FM hosted by Gilles Peterson (4hero, Roberta Flack, UK bass MC Magugu, Penny Penny via Awesome Tapes From Africa, a Dr Muruti remix, dubstep pioneer Mala). AfroBank FM hosted by Palms Trax and Burna Boy (Asake, Seyi Vibez, DJ Lag, Robot Boii ft. Kamo Mphela, Tony Allen & The Afro Messengers). Flash FM includes Daft Punk, X-Press 2, Charli XCX, David Byrne, PinkPantheress and Calvin Harris, with Robyn among the presenters. PinkPantheress also hosts Stockyard FM. Kaleidoscope FM covers Finnish disco, global pop and obscure electronica, with Jeremy Irons as a reporter. Radio On-U is named after Adrian Sherwood's dub label On-U Sound. Weird Al Yankovic hosts Vice City FM; Bad Bunny and RaiNao present Latin station Cocoteo.
Real world: this weekend Miami's Club Space hosts a three-day takeover inspired by The Vault, with sets from Justice, Chris Lorenzo, Sammy Virji, Demi Riquísimo, DJ Tennis, Palms Trax, Seth Troxler and Skream, among others.
Reaction: Max Dean and Black Lounge reacted on DJ Mag's Instagram post ('Bickering has been freed'); fans joked it will turn gamers into DJs.

article: Grand Theft Auto VI came out worldwide this week, and club music has a big presence in it. One of its 22 radio stations is CircoLoco Records Radio. Seth Troxler hosts it, and it plays a batch of tracks that haven't been released yet.

The unreleased tracks are CHRIS STASSY's 'We On This Ride', DJ Tennis's 'Never Look Back' featuring Tomike, and 'I Feel Love' by Chloé Caillet & Myd. Also on the list: Mind Against's 'Let It Go', Carlita & Barker's 'Last Night', Troxler's own 'Bootlicker' and Rossi. & Demi's 'Deep N Sexy'. There are two remixes as well, Max Dean on Black Lounge's 'Bickering' and DJ Lag & Palms Trax on Rampa's 'The Church'. Released tracks by Michael Bibi, KETTAMA, PAWSA and Skream fill out the playlist.

There's more for club listeners. French duo Justice composed the game's original score. A hidden 23rd station called The Vault Radio reportedly unlocks once you find a poster inside The Vault, a fictional nightclub in downtown Vice City, and it plays the electronic mixes heard in that club. Gilles Peterson's Worldwide FM includes dubstep pioneer Mala, 4hero and the UK bass MC Magugu. Palms Trax and Burna Boy co-host AfroBank FM. Radio On-U takes its name from Adrian Sherwood's dub label On-U Sound. Flash FM includes Daft Punk and X-Press 2, and Robyn is one of its presenters.
The game also comes with a standalone 34-track album. Early reviews are overwhelmingly positive, and some critics already rank it among the best video games ever made.

The tie-in also carries over into real clubs. This weekend Miami's Club Space hosts a three-day takeover based on The Vault. Justice, Chris Lorenzo, Sammy Virji, Demi Riquísimo, DJ Tennis, Palms Trax, Seth Troxler and Skream are among the DJs playing.

written.caption:
GTA VI includes a CircoLoco station of unreleased club tracks, hosted by Seth Troxler.

There are new tracks from CHRIS STASSY, DJ Tennis, Chloé Caillet & Myd and Mind Against, plus a Max Dean remix. Justice wrote the score, and a hidden station plays the mixes from The Vault, the game's fictional nightclub.
